about: Where the research scripts may read, which model reads for them, and what that costs. Research runs as scripts: a script fetches the pages, DeepSeek reads only the fetched text, and a script checks every quoted sentence against that text. No Claude session is involved.

wikipedia_en.what: English Wikipedia, through its own service, as plain text with the revision number

wikipedia_simple.what: Simple English Wikipedia, where an article exists

nhm_dino_directory.what: Natural History Museum, London: the Dino Directory page
nhm_dino_directory.found_by: a fixed address pattern, dinosaurs only

amnh.found_by: a page address a person has written under `hints`; its addresses cannot be worked out from a name

kew.what: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew: for plants
kew.found_by: a page address a person has written under `hints`, until a search by name is built

banned: fan wikis, such as fandom.com and wikia
rule: A script fetches only from the hosts listed under `sources`. Nothing else is read, so a banned kind of site cannot get in.
prices_note: Peak prices are used for every estimate, so the real cost is this or less. Off-peak is half.
